# TypeForge

> TypeForge is a free, modern typing speed trainer and WPM test platform designed to help users improve their typing speed, accuracy, and muscle memory through structured lessons, character drills, speed tests, and typing games.

## What is TypeForge?

TypeForge (https://typeforge.site) is an advanced online typing practice platform. It offers a progressive lesson system, real-time WPM and accuracy tracking, adaptive character drills, paragraph typing tests, timed speed tests, and typing games — all for free, with no sign-up required.

## Key Features

- **Structured Lessons**: 10 progressive lessons from home row keys to full keyboard mastery
- **Character Drill**: Adaptive single-key practice weighted by your weakest keys
- **Speed Test**: 1, 3, 5, and 10 minute timed typing tests with WPM and accuracy results
- **Paragraph Typing**: Real-text paragraph practice for natural typing flow
- **Typing Games**: Fun games to build speed without feeling like practice
- **Rank System**: Global leaderboard and personal rank tracking
- **Dashboard**: Detailed stats — WPM history, accuracy trends, key-level heatmaps
- **XP & Streaks**: Gamified progress to keep you motivated
- **Finger Guide**: Color-coded keyboard with finger zone highlighting
- **No account needed**: All progress saved locally; optional sign-in to sync across devices

## Who is TypeForge for?

- Beginners learning touch typing from scratch
- Students preparing for SSC, CGL, CHSL, bank, railway, court, steno, and government exam typing tests
- Professionals improving data entry or coding speed
- Kids and school students learning to type
- Anyone wanting to beat their WPM personal best

## Comparisons

TypeForge is a free alternative to MonkeyType, TypeRacer, Keybr, and TypingClub. It combines the best features of all these tools — adaptive drills like Keybr, speed tests like MonkeyType, races like TypeRacer, and structured lessons like TypingClub — in a single modern platform.

## Technical

- Built with Next.js and React
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers
- No ads, no paywalls, no account required
- Offline-capable (progress saved in localStorage)
